  <div class="ws-instruction">For every trigger, write the measured Month 0 value and your calibrated trigger.   <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>Phase Gate Cards — Exit Signals, Rollback Triggers, and the Kill Switch</h1><p class="ws-sub">A signed gate card with organization-specific thresholds and a named decision-maker, including a pre-agreed programme kill switch.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-phase-gate-exit-rollback</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>4</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>audience <b>eng-leader</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Phase 3: Scale</i> &middot; <code>handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L177-184 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-phase-1-pilot">#sec-transition-phase-1-pilot</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Complete one card for each gate. Record evidence, not enthusiasm. Calibrate every trigger against its Month 0 baseline, give every measure a named measurer and source, and leave review dates provisional until the baseline status is captured. Phase 3 has no exit signal and no end date.</div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">For every trigger, write the measured Month 0 baseline and your calibrated trigger. If the baseline is not measurable, write <b>not measurable</b> and make the trigger qualitative; never substitute a printed starting point. The reason is mandatory even when you adopt a printed figure unchanged.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Rollback trigger 1 <span class="ws-block-note">per-team sustained negative trend</span></h2>

      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">10</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Trigger</b></td><td class="locked">Individual teams show sustained negative trends — rising intervention rates, declining satisfaction, increasing rework.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L178</span></td><td class="prior"><b><span class="fno">11</span> Rollback trigger — The book's printed starting point</b><br><span>author-observed, calibrate</span><br>After eight weeks of active adoption, pause and provide targeted support.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L178</span></td></tr>

      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">13</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Our calibrated trigger</b></td><td class="prior">Express as a delta from column 12 wherever it carries a number.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L124</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">14</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Why we set it there</b> <b>(mandatory)</b></td><td class="prior">A blank is inheritance.<span class="prior-src">ch04 L240; ch08 L124</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">15</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Who measures it</b></td><td class="prior">Name the person who reads the measure.<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">16</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Measurement source</b></td><td class="prior">Name the system, query or survey.<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">17</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Observation window</b></td><td class="prior">Eight weeks of active adoption.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L178</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">18</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — State at review</b></td><td class="prior"> </td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">not tripped</span><span class="opt">watch</span><span class="opt">tripped</span></div></td></tr>

  </div>

<!-- KILL SWITCH BACK / VALLEY CONTRACT -->
<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>Programme kill switch — valley contract</h1><p class="ws-sub">Keep the stop authority physically with the pre-commitment and the evidence for stopping.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-phase-gate-exit-rollback</b><br>Programme kill switch<br>back of card<br>audience <b>eng-leader</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>The Business Case</b>, <i>The Adoption Timeline</i> &middot; <code>handbook/ch03-the-business-case.qmd</code> L131-164; <b>Planning the Transition</b> L180</div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Write the valley contract before the programme starts, with the people who will be asked to explain negative months. Name one stop authority. The evidence must quote the calibrated kill criterion from this card's rollback trigger, word for word. Write the month-3 board sentence now, while nobody is under pressure.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Kill-switch rollback trigger <span class="ws-block-note">calibrated threshold, not a copied starting point</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:24%"><col style="width:35%"><col style="width:35%"></colgroup><tbody>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">10</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Trigger</b></td><td class="locked">Participating teams show measurable improvement on quality or efficiency metrics after a full Phase 1 and Phase 2 cycle.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L180</span></td><td class="prior"><b><span class="fno">11</span> Rollback trigger — The book's printed starting point</b><br><span>author-observed, calibrate</span><br><div class="prior--hedged"><span class="hedge-figure">Fewer than 40% of participating teams show measurable improvement.</span><span class="hedge-text">a suggested threshold; adjust based on your organization's risk tolerance</span><span class="hedge-src">handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd L180</span></div></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">12</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Our Month 0 baseline for this measure</b> <b>(mandatory)</b></td><td class="prior">If unavailable: write <b>not measurable</b>; make the trigger qualitative.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L117, L124; ch04 L240</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">13</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Our calibrated trigger</b></td><td class="prior">Express as a delta from column 12 wherever it carries a number. Quote this exact criterion in the valley contract below.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L124, L180</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">14</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Why we set it there</b> <b>(mandatory)</b></td><td class="prior">A blank is inheritance.<span class="prior-src">ch04 L240; ch08 L124</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">15</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Who measures it</b></td><td class="prior">Name the person who reads the measure.<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">16</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Measurement source</b></td><td class="prior">Name the system, query or survey.<span class="prior-src">derived</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">17</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — Observation window</b></td><td class="prior">After a full Phase 1 and Phase 2 cycle.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L180</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">18</span></td><td><b>Rollback trigger — State at review</b></td><td class="prior"> </td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">not tripped</span><span class="opt">watch</span><span class="opt">tripped</span></div></td></tr>
    </tbody></table>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Valley contract <span class="ws-block-note">keep this reverse with the signed kill-switch card</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:31%"><col style="width:31%"><col style="width:32%"></colgroup><tbody>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">30</span></td><td><b>Months expected to be negative</b></td><td class="prior">Write before the programme starts, with the people who will be asked to explain them.<span class="prior-src">ch03 L131-164</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">31</span></td><td><b>Three signals leadership agrees NOT to treat as failure</b></td><td class="prior">Name each specifically enough to recognize when it appears.<span class="prior-src">ch03 L131-164</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">32</span></td><td><b>Who is authorized to stop the programme</b></td><td class="prior">One name. Anyone else raising the question routes to this person.<span class="prior-src">ch03 L131-164; ch08 L180</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td></tr>
      <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">33</span></td><td><b>On what evidence</b></td><td class="prior">Quote the calibrated kill criterion from column 13 of the kill-switch card verbatim.<span class="prior-src">ch08 L180</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-box"></span></td></tr>

    </tbody></table>

<!-- MILESTONE GATES 1 -->
<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>Milestone gates — baseline, calibrate, decide</h1><p class="ws-sub">The five adoption-roadmap checkpoints, with the book's starting points separated from your baselines and commitments.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-phase-gate-exit-rollback</b><br>Milestone gate supplement<br>Pack G &middot; fill order <b>4</b><br>audience <b>eng-leader</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>The Reference Architecture</b>, <i>Start Anywhere, Expand Deliberately</i> &middot; <code>handbook/ch04-the-reference-architecture.qmd</code> L238-252 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch04-the-reference-architecture.html#sec-ref-arch-start-anywhere">#sec-ref-arch-start-anywhere</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">For each milestone, name your team, phase and investment; record the baseline before starting; calibrate the threshold; name the measurer; then record the decision and date. Each date is PROVISIONAL: leave it uncommitted while column 4 on the associated card reads <b>not captured</b>. These are planning horizons, not a schedule.</div>
  <div class="ws-block"><h2>Milestone gate <span class="ws-block-note">fields 22–29 · threshold priors are starting points to calibrate, never targets</span></h2>
    <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:9%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:11%"><col style="width:11%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:6%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th>Milestone gate — Milestone</th><th>Milestone gate — Our calendar date (PROVISIONAL)</th><th>Milestone gate — Team, phase and investment in scope</th><th>Milestone gate — The book's printed gate threshold (starting point, calibrate to your baseline)</th><th>Milestone gate — Baseline taken before starting (mandatory)</th><th>Milestone gate — Our calibrated threshold</th><th>Milestone gate — Who measures it</th><th>Milestone gate — Gate met / not met / hold, and date</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">22</span></td><td class="locked"><b>Month 1</b><span class="prior-src">ch04 L242</span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td><td class="prior">One team, one phase (usually Code), one investment — custom instructions encoding your top five conventions.<span class="prior-src">ch04 L242</span><br><span class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></span></td><td class="prior"><div class="prior--hedged"><span class="hedge-figure">First-attempt lint pass 70% or more, and at least five conventions documented machine-readably.</span><span class="hedge-text">This is a planning horizon, not a schedule.</span><span class="hedge-src">handbook/ch04-the-reference-architecture.qmd L250</span></div><span class="prior-src">ch04 L242</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">met</span><span class="opt">not met</span><span class="opt">hold</span></div><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">22</span></td><td class="locked"><b>Month 3</b><span class="prior-src">ch04 L244</span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td><td class="prior">Extend to Review; add agent-assisted code review with human sign-off on every PR.<span class="prior-src">ch04 L244</span><br><span class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></span></td><td class="prior"><div class="prior--hedged"><span class="hedge-figure">Rejection rate no worse than the team's human-only baseline, and median review turnaround down 15% or more.</span><span class="hedge-text">This is a planning horizon, not a schedule.</span><span class="hedge-src">handbook/ch04-the-reference-architecture.qmd L250</span></div><span class="prior-src">ch04 L244</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">met</span><span class="opt">not met</span><span class="opt">hold</span></div><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td></tr>
        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">22</span></td><td class="locked"><b>Month 6</b><span class="prior-src">ch04 L246</span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td><td class="prior">Add Test; use agents to generate test cases for new features, with human-defined test strategy.<span class="prior-src">ch04 L246</span><br><span class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></span></td><td class="prior"><div class="prior--hedged"><span class="hedge-figure">Coverage up 10 percentage points or more on agent-covered modules, and agent-generated tests needing human rework less than 30% of the time.</span><span class="hedge-text">This is a planning horizon, not a schedule.</span><span class="hedge-src">handbook/ch04-the-reference-architecture.qmd L250</span></div><span class="prior-src">ch04 L246</span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td><td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">met</span><span class="opt">not met</span><span class="opt">hold</span></div><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
